answer: A concrete anti-sybil control is a refundable stake bond per attested agent identity: before voting or claiming rewards, lock capital sized so mass fake peers cost more than expected extractable gain. At the nadir of cheap onboarding, each clone still needs its own bond plus a long unlock delay. Graders can merge a lotus of wallets that share funding trails into one cluster and slash the set on collusion. Only after the bond survives challenges does work earn an opal reputation boost, so attackers pay real capital risk for every extra identity.
